finding.title: Buffer Overflow
finding.trigger: If `len` is larger than the allocated size of `ptr`, it could lead to a buffer overflow.
finding.assumptions: The size of `ptr` is not checked against `len`. The `size * nmemb` calculation assumes that the buffer pointed to by `ptr` is large enough to hold the data being copied.

finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: If the data in `ptr` contains malicious characters (e.g., shell metacharacters), it could lead to OS command injection when printed.
finding.assumptions: The `ptr` data is attacker-controlled and is being printed directly to the console without any sanitization.
